correctness.rationale: The full proof shows rooted unicycle closure, invariance, and positive-transition irreducibility; meeting of underlying walks in O_P(M) steps, two-step hitting bound q=m/((m+1)(M+1))~1/M, and erasure of every arrow give the upper cutoff. A valid adversarial initial unicycle has M^epsilon untouched arrows with high probability before the lower cutoff; stationary symmetry bounds the same target-pointer count by M/m=O(1). The exact finite script confirms 12430 state-transition, two-step and occupancy-variance assertions, but infinity relies on analytic proof.
